How much is a used Carhartt Detroit jacket worth?

Vintage Carhartt workwear is a strong resale category. Worn and faded jackets can sell for more than clean new ones.

Updated 2026-11-06 · by FlipLens

Which one do you have?

Carhartt (the American workwear brand) and Carhartt WIP (its European streetwear line) are different labels. Vintage Detroit jackets have a blanket lining and a corduroy collar. The label style tells roughly how old the jacket is.

What decides the price

  • Line and age: vintage American Carhartt versus recent WIP pieces.
  • Wear: natural fading is valued, but large tears and stains are not.
  • Colour: brown (Carhartt Brown) and black are classics.
  • Size: work sizes run large.

Check before you buy

  • Read the label and the country of origin.
  • Check the lining, cuffs and collar.
  • Measure the pit-to-pit width.

Where it sells best

Sells on Vinted, eBay and vintage marketplaces. Put "vintage" and the model in the title and show the label.

Today's price

Prices for a used Carhartt Detroit jacket change every week, so this page gives no fixed numbers. Questions

How much is a used Carhartt Detroit jacket worth?

It depends on vintage or WIP, wear, size and colour. Prices change weekly, so check today's value: type "Carhartt Detroit jacket" and the condition into FlipLens (fliplens.eu), which compares current eBay listings in the UK and five EU countries and shows the expected sale price and the most worth paying.

Are worn Carhartt jackets worth anything?

Yes, faded and worn vintage Carhartt is in demand. Heavy damage still lowers the price.

Is Carhartt WIP worth as much as vintage Carhartt?

They are different markets: recent WIP clothing usually sells for less than sought-after vintage pieces.
